functional_capture_law: Persist only exact functional encounter truth: datetime, opaque beingId, path, method and status. clientRequestQuery is never requested.

recognition_law.scheme: private HMAC network recognition followed by existing artwork-ID derivation
recognition_law.key_custody: GitHub Actions secret CRAWLERBAIT_ID_KEY; never repository bytes
recognition_law.rotation_law: A changed key with the same epoch is a continuity error and capture must fail.

query_law.reason: not required for Bait identity, Being continuity, Being kind, walk topology or current public embodiment

phenotype_law.provider_dimensions: all other currently advertised fields that can be lawfully sensed
phenotype_law.field_width_resolution: recursive tetrahedral 1→4 shards beneath provider maxNumberOfFields
phenotype_law.publication: keyed irreversible per-Being phenotype interference only

public_law: Canonical traffic carriers in this public repository contain metabolized functional encounters plus opaque phenotype only; recognition material is absent.
bootstrap_law: When the canonical cursor is uninitialized, capture begins at the live provider retention boundary and advances incrementally.

legacy_404_evidence.law: Preserve as partial historical 404 evidence only. Never extend it and never mix its counts with canonical request counts.

historical_note: Pre-v5 Git history already published richer raw traces. On the first authoritative v5 Tide, current-tree v4 auxiliary values are condensed into keyed irreversible per-Being phenotype DNA (query excluded) before readable raw fields retire; earlier Git history is not rewritten.
